BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives MacEwen, Smith, Stambaugh, Muri, Buys, Griffey, Hayes, and Wilson
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Restricting the use of bond proceeds to pay certain taxes on transportation projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restricting the use of bond proceeds to pay certain taxes on transportation projects; amending RCW 39.42.040; and creating new sections.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature intends this act to stop the policy of financing amounts that are used to pay sales and use taxes on transportation projects. This is a responsible way to reduce debt and the overall cost of projects.
This act may be known and cited as the do not bond taxes act.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. RCW 39.42.040 and 1971 ex.s. c 184 s 4 are each amended to read as follows:Disposition of proceeds from sale of bonds.
BillSection.P: (1) The proceeds of the sale of any bonds shall be used solely for the purposes, including any expense incurred in connection with the issuance and sale of such bonds, specified in the general statute or special act authorizing the issuance of such bonds.

P.TextRun: (2) The proceeds of the sale of any bonds issued for transportation purposes may not pay any tax levied pursuant to chapter 82.08, 82.12, or 82.14 RCW.
